The '''Seikoshan rebel camp''' was located in the jungles outside the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Cairn (city)|Cairn]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Seikosha/Legends|Seikosha]]. It was inhabited by [[Seikoshan]]s who were disgruntled with the way the local [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] treated their [[Species/Legends|species]] and planet.
